whatIs: 97cosas.com is the collaborative Spanish translation of O'Reilly's "97 Things" series, a collection of short essays written by industry professionals. The volume for programmers is now complete; the Project Manager and Software Architect volumes are listed as projects in progress.
It's a good fit for short readings on the craft and best practices, which you can read one essay at a time, in any order.
uses: Reading a programming tip in your spare time, without committing to an entire book.
Putting together a reading list of best practices for your team or for a new hire.
Finding a reference in Spanish to justify a design or process decision in a code review.
caveats: Only the programmers volume is finished; the other two are still in progress.
They're opinion essays by different authors: they're good for reflection, not as a technical manual with code.
The translations are community-made and licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3: if you reuse them, you must give attribution.
pricingNote: Free content under the Creative Commons Attribution 3 license.
idealFor: People who want short readings in Spanish about the craft of programming.
